menu.sectionsSubtitle: Starters, mains, desserts... The order is the order they're eaten in.

products.sortByExpiryHint: Sorts items by the batch that expires soonest
products.yieldHint: How much of what you buy is usable. Potatoes that get peeled yield 90%.
products.yieldAbove100: Yields more than it takes in: no waste generated.
products.yieldOnlyPercentHint: This item isn't measured by weight, so yield goes in percent.
products.yieldNote: The gap between the two lines is what trim waste costs you.
products.noCostChanges: No purchases or yield changes in this period
products.yieldUnreliableBody: Purchase cost is exact all the way back: it comes from the movement ledger, which is immutable. What started being recorded that day is the yield.

maintenance.title: No connection to the system
maintenance.body: We couldn't connect. It may be an update in progress or a network problem. We're retrying automatically.

foodCost.yieldNotice: Cost now includes each item's yield
foodCost.yieldNoticeBody: If a recipe calls for 200 g of peeled potato, you're charged the 222 g you had to buy. Dishes using items with a yield set show a higher cost than before — nothing broke, that factor was missing.
foodCost.historySubtitle: How the dish's price and food cost moved over time.
foodCost.unreliableBody: History started being recorded that day. For earlier dates you see the value at that moment, not what was actually in effect.

plan.loadError: Could not load the account information.
plan.chargesByMp: Charges are made by Mercado Pago, which sends you a receipt for each one.

plan.cancelledUntil: You cancelled the subscription. You keep the {plan} plan until {date}; after that you move to the trial plan.
plan.pendingCheckout: You have an unfinished payment in Mercado Pago. If you already paid, it may take a few minutes to confirm; if not, choose the plan again.
plan.confirming: Confirming your payment with Mercado Pago…

plan.trialHint: You are on the trial plan. Choose a plan to use all of Chef Control.

plan.cancelMessage: Mercado Pago stops charging you. You keep the {plan} plan until {date}; after that the account moves to the trial plan.

plan.closeAccountWarning: This deletes the account with all its restaurants ({restaurants}) and their data, the roles, the audit log and its users ({users}). It cannot be undone.
plan.deleteMessage: Everything is deleted: each restaurant with its stock, purchases, sales, waste, recipes and menu, the roles, the audit log and the account users. Nothing is left and it cannot be recovered.
plan.deleteHelper: You will be signed out as soon as it is deleted.
